scope_limit: ModelProof is currently bounded to reviewing supplied model documentation, evaluation evidence, limitations, approvals, change records and declared gaps for authorised human model-governance review. It does not certify model validity, guarantee performance or safety, approve deployment, accept risk, grant regulatory approval, or authorise external release.
review_pack_title: DIO ModelProof Controlled Evidence Review Pack
human_gate_reason: Model validation conclusions, performance or safety claims, deployment approval, risk acceptance, regulatory conclusions and final release remain with authorised model, risk and governance owners.
